one_sentence_story: One small sweet and rich snack a day for eight weeks rewires your reward spot. Plain food starts to taste dull even when your weight stays flat.
so_what_for_you: Do not trust a flat bathroom scale when you eat daily sweet treats. Swap rich snacks for fruit or nuts for three weeks so real food tastes bright.

jargon_map.plain: fat plus sugar in one bite hits your reward spot twice as hard
jargon_map.analogy: like pressing two gas pedals on one car at the same time

jargon_map.plain: your brain learns to crave the time and room linked to a treat
jargon_map.analogy: like a dog running in the second a treat jar clicks

jargon_map.plain: your brain's 'I am full' switch grows slow after days of rich snacks
jargon_map.analogy: like a heat dial that fails to click off in a warm room

jargon_map.plain: loud sweet snacks make plain whole food taste flat next to them
jargon_map.analogy: like walking out of a loud show where soft talk sounds mute
